scene_description: A candid, documentary-style photograph set on a residential street in Alberton, South Africa. A professional lead mover wearing an unbranded black one-piece work overall stands next to the cab of a large, completely unmarked white moving truck. He has a realistic light sweat sheen and minor dust on his clothing from the day's work. He is focused, holding a rugged digital tablet displaying a generic GPS map interface, coordinating the route. In the blurred background, another mover in identical black overalls is securing the back of the truck. The image visually conveys security, real-time fleet monitoring, and professional logistics. Natural midday daylight, raw film grain, candid composition, zero corporate logos or branding anywhere.
visual_details: Alberton street, professional mover, unbranded black overalls, minor sweat/dust, holding rugged tablet with GPS map, unmarked white truck, fleet monitoring, security, natural daylight, documentary photography, film grain.
camera_settings: Shot on Kodak Portra 400, 35mm lens, f/4.0, 1/250 sec, ISO 200. Clean, realistic daylight, focus on the mover and tablet.

scene_description: A detailed documentary-style photograph taken inside the cargo hold of an unmarked moving truck, focusing on 'highway-ready' preparation for a long-distance national trip. Two South African movers in unbranded black one-piece overalls are expertly securing a large, valuable wooden dining table. The furniture is heavily padded with thick, professional-grade grey moving blankets and tightly bound in layers of clear shrink wrap. One mover, showing visible exertion and a sweat sheen, is meticulously applying heavy-duty brown packing tape strictly to the plastic wrap layers, ensuring the tape does not touch the wood surface. The ambient natural light from the open truck rear highlights the robust, secure padding technique meant for rough N1 or N3 highway transit. Gritty, realistic film texture.
visual_details: Inside moving truck, heavy highway-ready padding, unbranded black overalls, thick moving blankets, clear shrink wrap, tape applied perfectly to plastic only, meticulous preparation, sweat and effort, raw documentary style, film grain, zero branding.
camera_settings: Shot on Tri-X 400 film, 50mm lens, f/2.8, 1/125 sec, ISO 800. Ambient light from truck opening, sharp focus on the padding technique and hands.

scene_description: A wide, dynamic documentary photograph set outside a modern, clean commercial business estate with landscaped greenery (resembling Joanique Eco Park). A highly coordinated team of three South African movers, all wearing matching unbranded black one-piece overalls, are executing a seamless, comprehensive office move. One mover is efficiently pushing a metal dolly loaded with neatly stacked, unmarked cardboard boxes; another is carrying a fully blanket-wrapped and securely taped executive desk; the third is seen in the background holding cleaning supplies, preparing to do a post-move sweep. They show natural sweat from exertion in the bright South African sun. The scene captures an efficient, all-in-one moving, packing, and clearing crew working as a single unit. Candid, natural daylight, visible film grain, zero text or branding.
visual_details: Modern eco-park business estate, coordinated team of three movers, unbranded black overalls, simultaneous moving/packing/cleaning tasks, loaded dolly, wrapped furniture, physical effort under midday sun, comprehensive service, documentary photo, candid.
camera_settings: Shot on Fujifilm Velvia 50, 24mm lens, f/8.0, 1/400 sec. Bright, high-contrast natural daylight, wide depth of field.
